name: First Log Line After a Time
desc:
A huge log file is sorted by time. times holds the timestamp of each line in order (several lines can share a timestamp). Your task is to return the index of the first line with a timestamp greater than or equal to t, or len(times) if there is none.

Write the binary search yourself (no bisect): O(log n).

Example

For times = [1, 3, 3, 3, 8], t = 3, the output should be

1
[execution time limit] 4 seconds (py3)
[memory limit] 1 GB
[input] array.integer times
[input] integer t
[output] integer
hints: lo = 0, hi = len(times) ; tant que lo < hi : mid ; si times[mid] < t alors lo = mid + 1, sinon hi = mid.
Avec des doublons, il faut le PREMIER indice : ne t'arrête pas dès que tu trouves t.
summary_fr: Liste triée d'horodatages : renvoyer l'indice de la première ligne dont l'heure est >= t (len(times) s'il n'y en a pas), en O(log n), sans le module bisect.
